author: Fluffabru
body:
It can be sometimes op but it's a gamblers pet. 

As a lvl227 Beo/Tamer, the mark/execution combo does around 60k+ or 300k+ redlined. (I don't have d.channel yet)

If it used the combo consistently it would be op, though I find that it likes to spam execution or its other skills before the mark is applied. For balance I assume.

In raids I feel like I'm waiting a while for it to work sometimes. The Chimera I take feels like it out does it in dps.  I think back in Tier 9 or 8 it might of been more useful for me then but not sure.

In pvp he is really good against those that turtle, like Gilga or Diety. The combo can take a while to happen but it's a matter of when.

For a 6* pet his damage can be crazy, he looks cool and different, and only costs gold. I'd say he is worth trying.

author: JustAnotherPeasant01
body: It requires a lot of action % additions to be strong, and it requires doing 2 skills in the correct order near enough to pop the mark. It has hurdles but is impressive damage when it happens... then again compare how often it happens to the consistent pet of a similar tier like arcane slime, war horse or dark dragon.
